headline: No crew starts work on an unconfirmed isolation
capabilities: Checks each work request before a permit is raised
Drafts the risk assessment with hazards, controls and PPE
Confirms the isolation with the control room before the crew accepts
Reconciles close-out and rebuilds the signed audit trail
outcomes: Every crew starts on a confirmed isolation
Sign-offs are visible against each planned start
Close-out and the permit record are complete and signed
why_try: The demo follows one high-risk transformer permit from the morning queue to close-out, catching a missing lockout and a missing tool along the way.
